speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Four on the settle. A capon between you. Fourteen pence a head, and I am telling you the price before the ale makes it a debate.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: We will have ale. We have been a king all week, and a king does not ask twice.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: We are amazed, and thus long have we stood to watch the fearful bending of thy knee.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Seven-and-twenty, and deposed already. I drink to the man, not to the king he will not put down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A gift, in a cloth. A small looking-glass, in a pearwood frame. Two shillings and sixpence. To practise on. John's glass is in the chest, and that is the one thou'lt break.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: It is not Richard who looks. Leave it. A man is allowed one face that is not the part.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I will sing, and I will not make the song a speech about the glass. The chest had my silence this afternoon. The settle can have the tune.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: The slate is forgiven for one night only. Fourteen pence is still the price. I am not in the habit, and I am not your gatherer.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Forgiven, and heard. I am not putting the capon on Will's account. He has already paid for the glass.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The glass is the gift. The capon is Agnes's kindness. I am not writing either of them into the coffer.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: One week he has had the king's leaves. He has not come out of them. The ale was in the plural. We all heard the plural.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The plural can sit down. I have another verse, and then I am done. Birthdays do not need a third.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: A third verse and I charge the slate again. Two, and the night is a gift. I am the hostess, not the tiring-house.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Two, then. I am seven-and-twenty. I can count.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The leaves were a week ago. Tonight is the glass, and the capon, and Augustine's two. I am not bringing a Parliament in here.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Good. Deposed already was the joke. I am not spending the rest of the capon on a scene that is not licensed.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Eat. The forgiven slate lasts till I say the ordinary is shut, and I have not said it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Shut is your word. The song is mine. That is the division.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Will stays till nine. I know the shape of him. At nine he will stand up and call a pain by a city's name.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not yet. The city can wait for the hour. The capon is still here.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Pearwood. I have seen worse frames come in as a pledge. This one is a gift, and gifts do not go on my board as a debt.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two and six, paid before I came in. You will not find it on a tally of mine.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then the health stands, and the glass stands, and the king can be a man for the length of a capon.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: A man, for the length of a capon. I accept the term. I do not promise it will survive the street.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The second verse is short. I am not spending it on the door.
